newsitem.title: EGYPT: Palestinians ask Arabs to isolate Israel.
newsitem.headline: Palestinians ask Arabs to isolate Israel.

text.p: The Palestinian Authority asked Arab governments on Thursday to isolate and punish Israel for its actions in the West Bank and Gaza.

"We implore you to provide help and work by every means to isolate Israel, punish it and show up its aggression until it refrains from this perverse aggressive behaviour," Palestinian delegate Mohamed Sobeih told an Arab League meeting.
"Until it refrains from trampling underfoot all U.N. resolutions...so that no more blood is shed," he added.

Sobeih was addressing an emergency meeting of permanent delegates to the Arab League, called by Palestine in response to Israel's decision to reopen a tunnel under the Wailing Wall in Jerusalem. Fifteen Palestinians have been shot dead in the Palestinian territories in the subsequent protests.
"Palestinian land has been turned into fields of war, on which many martyrs have fallen," Sobeih added.
Arab League Secretary-General Esmat Adbel-Meguid opened the meeting with a call for a moment's silence for the dead.
